stem: A bullet is fired at a speed of 50 m/s at an angle of $37{^\circ}$ with the horizontal. At the same instant, a wooden block is released from the top of a vertical pole. The bullet strikes the block at a height of 45 m from the ground. What is the horizontal distance of the pole from the point where the bullet was fired?

assets.alt: A gun aimed along a 37° line at a block on top of a 90 m pole, 40 × 3 = 120 m away; the block falls while the bullet curves, and they meet at 45 m at t = 3 s.
